_comment: Ratchet baseline for CLAUDE.md section 4 gates that cannot pass yet. These counts may only DECREASE. Raising a number is a regression and must be rejected in review. Delete an entry once its gate is clean, and make that gate hard-blocking.

_targets.credo_issues: reduced opportunistically; no slice owns it yet
_targets.dialyzer_warnings: no slice owns reduction yet; gate is ratcheted
_targets.hex_audit_advisories: advisory only; no ratchet yet -- see BACKLOG

_method.test_failures: sum of 'N failures' across umbrella apps in `mix test`
_method.credo_issues: sum of all FIVE credo summary categories in `mix credo --strict`
_method.hex_audit_advisories: count of '^  <pkg> <version>' lines in `mix hex.audit` (superset of deps.audit)
_method.deps_audit_advisories: count of '^Name:' lines in `mix do deps.loadpaths + deps.audit`

_corrections.reason: 60 was a mis-measurement: it counted :warn_* atoms excluding warn_unknown, an undocumented method. 61 is dialyzer's own `Total errors` and is what the gate now reads. Raising a baseline is otherwise forbidden; this entry is the audit record that makes the increase reviewable. See FINDINGS.md F3/H5.
